WITH pf AS (
    SELECT pi.person_id
    FROM (
        SELECT it.id
        FROM info_type AS it
        WHERE it.info = 'mini biography'
    ) AS matching_info
    JOIN person_info AS pi
        ON pi.info_type_id = matching_info.id
        AND pi.note = 'Volker Boehm'
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS of_person, MIN(t.title) AS biography_movie
FROM pf
JOIN name AS n
    ON n.id = pf.person_id
    AND n.gender = 'm'
    AND n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
JOIN aka_name AS an
    ON an.person_id = n.id
    AND an.name LIKE '%a%'
JOIN cast_info AS ci
    ON ci.person_id = n.id
JOIN title AS t
    ON t.id = ci.movie_id
    AND t.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
JOIN movie_link AS ml
    ON ml.linked_movie_id = t.id
JOIN link_type AS lt
    ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id
    AND lt.link = 'features'
